timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹91.86 Cr (-2.7% YoY), net profit ₹0.4 Cr (-97.5% YoY).
Imagicaaworld's board approved investing up to ₹100 Cr in Mehsana Next Parks Private Limited for Shanku's Water Park.
Malpani Parks Private Limited, promoter of Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited, confirmed no encumbrance on its shares during FY2025-26 on 03/04/2026 via Mr. Sanjay Omkarnath Malpani, Director.
Imagicaaworld reported Q2FY27 footfalls of 2.1 lakh (-6% YoY), approved the sale of Novotel Imagicaa for ₹248 Cr, and received ₹129.45 Cr from warrant conversions.
Imagicaaworld issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for the ₹248 Cr slump sale of Hotel Novotel Imagicaa to Juniper Hotels.
